comments.text:
Hello Trace The Globe,
Thank you so much for making such a beautiful and enjoyable video, introducing Vietnam to our International friends.
One regrettable, or rather sad, thing is that you DID NOT visit two other famous cities in Vietnam: Hue and Da Lat. Hue is the Former Capital of Vietnam, where you can find the Royal Tombs and Ancient Citadels of the Vietnamese feudal Dynasty.
While Da Lat is a very romantic city with a much colder climate compared to other Vietnamese cities.
Hopefully, in your next video introducing Vietnam to International friends, you will visit these two cities.

replies.author: @TraceTheGlobe
replies.text: Thank you so much for this thoughtful comment and recommendation! You're absolutely right—Hue and Da Lat are two remarkable destinations, each with a very different character and history.
